acceptance: nightly-v2 has a throughput domain that runs the DuckDB and CedarDB cells and posts the same commit status as throughput-uat-signal.
The floor-history lookup reads the new workflow's scheduled runs (or imports the nightly.yml samples), shown by a dispatched run reporting the same sample count as the last nightly.yml run.
A workflow test pins the domain and its history lookup.
context: Found in the 2026-10-09 tracker review. Related: monitor-nightly-cedardb-throughput-gate-and-floor (watches the gate in nightly.yml today), dlv2-70-retire-scheduled-workflows (must wait for this port).
description:
nightly.yml runs throughput-uat (nightly.yml:707) and throughput-uat-signal (:804). Since #2757 the CedarDB cell gates the nightly, and the Throughput@Size floor learns from scheduled nightly.yml history (`--workflow nightly.yml ... --event schedule`, nightly.yml:755; minimum samples per runner class in tests/uat/throughput.py:203-212). nightly-v2.yml has no throughput, UAT or CedarDB job, and dlv2-70 deletes nightly.yml. Without a port, the throughput gate and its floor disappear when nightly.yml is retired.

Port both jobs into a nightly-v2 domain. Move the floor-history lookup to the new workflow's runs and artifact names, or carry the existing samples over, so the floor does not reset to 0 of 5.
